title: Artistic Bible — La Porte du Soleil (F10)
principles: Historical-feel cinematic, immersive, sober, sensory, emotionally powerful; story-truth first; nothing invented or over-claimed; 10/10 is an ambition measured on real media, never self-awarded.

rules.rule: World/era = original fantasy, Norse ∩ pharaonic (dramatized). Never present a design as verified historical fact.
Palette: cold Norse steel-grey vs Egyptian gold/ochre; twin-sun convergence = blinding gold → calm single-sun dawn.
Light must be motivated by in-scene sources; readable shadows; controlled contrast.
Performance contained by default; no overacting, grimacing or artificial sentimentality. Nuance stays PROPOSED until evidenced.
Camera/edit/music/FX serve the story — no gratuitous effects, impossible motion or added spectacle without justification.
canonRefs: F10 staging tags note no gratuitous combat/space

rules.rule: Character identity (face/morphology/hair/costume/props/wounds) consistent across shots vs reference sheets.
Composition: clear visual hierarchy; depth of field and camera moves motivated by action or POV.
Materials/architecture/objects/costumes plausible where sources allow; assumptions never stated as verified fact.
Sound: dialogue intelligibility, credible acoustic space, motivated ambiences, intentional silences, clean raccords. Do NOT invent or alter the 141 EN lines.
Continuity: morphology/hair/costume/props/wounds/orientation/emotional-state consistent; every visual break justified or FLAGGED for arbitration.
Twin-sun / double-dawn desync is MONOTONIC (worsens over time).
Wound continuity SC39 (inflicted) → SC48 (bound/healed) must read as the same wound progressing; exact staging HUMAN.
Olaf SC43–SC44: dies vs departs through the seam is a HUMAN arbitration — do NOT impose. Provide both readings.
Helgi carries a carved wooden horse for Sǫlveig; it is handed on (SC29→SC32→SC33→SC44). Prop must persist/transfer correctly.
AI-disclosure + commercial-rights-clear outputs required at publish; licensing of music/voice to be confirmed.

note: DA decisions deducible from F10 are taken; emotions/costumes/wounds/actions not in F10 are NOT invented. Human arbitrations stay visible with a PROPOSED recommendation where safe.
